label: GO step choosing a1 after a run of unrewarded trials, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0: 100% of mass; never after reward). It fires almost entirely when the agent picks a1 (model_act==1: 92% of mass; choice logit mostly +2.8..+8, i.e. a moderately confident a1 rather than a saturated one). It is strongest when a1 is a switch (stay==0: 6.7x lift) or follows an unrewarded S2 visit. It never fires before episode trial 10 and increases through the episode. The simple GO & prev unrewarded & choose a1 gets recall 0.87 / mass 0.92 but precision only 0.13. Most false positives are an isolated miss after a run of rewards. Also requiring the trial two back to be unrewarded, plus ep_trial>=30, gives the best dev F1 0.51 (P 0.45, R 0.59, mass 0.70). Read: a1 being chosen after recent reward drought. Never active at D1/D2, after rewarded trials, or (rarely) on a2 choices. Uses only observed history and the model own policy output, no future variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & last=a2 S2 u (+2.86), phase=GO & before=a1 S1 u (+2.01), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 u (+1.92), phase=GO & before=a2 S1 u (+1.70), ep_bucket=5 (+1.68), phase=GO & ep_dec=7 (+1.54). Lower it: model_act=0 (-6.84), prev_state=1 (-6.39), choice_bin=decile 0 (9 = most a1) (-3.73), phase=GO & choice_bin=decile 0 (9 = most a1) (-3.73).
